Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

strata.label: unresolved relation meaning
strata.definition: The complete relation dictionary and argument roles do not identify a coherent dominant predicate whose facts can be judged without inventing a scope.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicitly documented relation-level semantic indeterminacy after complete dictionary and argument-role inspection. Excludes: using ambiguity to omit difficult facts or change denominators; a broad association or disjunction invented to make unrelated meanings correct; using this marker when a coherent dominant family can be identified. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: all facts remain ambiguous because the relation meaning is unresolved. This is an evaluation marker, not a learned semantic relation. Every fact receives A with a case-specific question; retain all facts in denominators and separately report relation-semantic-indeterminacy counts.

strata.label: has minister
strata.definition: Country, government, or political administration X has or had person Y as an explicitly identified minister.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit minister of X or X's minister; a portfolio or prime minister office explicitly attached to X; historical ministerial office. Excludes: ordinary official, ambassador, or opposition politician without minister title; a minister of a different government merely meeting X; candidate or proposed appointment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: an incomplete national adjective in the institution slot; minister-designate without established tenure; unclear portfolio or government attachment. The inverse ministerial office does not assert that every minister is the head of government.

strata.label: played or competed against
strata.definition: Competitor X played or competed against opposing competitor Y in a contest.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit played against; a completed win or loss against opponent; competition with clear opponent roles. Excludes: ordinary interaction; standings comparison without a contest; future schedule alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: ambiguous game occurrence. Sensitivity-only for previously defeat-labeled relations unless a new primary assignment is explicitly frozen before grading. Not a union of unrelated meanings.

strata.label: owns organization or asset
strata.definition: Person or organization X owns or owned some or all of organization, business, team or property Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.

strata.label: owns organization or asset
strata.definition: Person or organization X owns or owned some or all of organization, business, team or property Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.

strata.label: lawyer or attorney for
strata.definition: Person X serves or served as attorney, lawyer or legal counsel for client, employer, organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer/attorney/counsel for/at/with client or employer; legal employment at a firm; explicit governmental attorney office for a jurisdiction. Excludes: private lawyer merely located in a city; spokesperson/director/lobbyist alone; reverse client-to-lawyer direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city as location versus represented jurisdiction; firm partner without a clear legal-role attachment.

strata.label: executive of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

strata.label: known or named as
strata.definition: Entity X is explicitly known, named, renamed, or referred to by alternative name Y for the same entity.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit known-as or also-called identity; a stated alias or alternative name; historical renaming of the same entity. Excludes: a named subsidiary or distinct entity; comparison or resemblance rather than identity; ordinary description without an alternative designation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear referent of the alternative name; an explicitly proposed new name without established use; name versus separate institution when unresolved. The predicate concerns two names or designations of one referent. Do not infer identity from an ownership relationship.

strata.label: managerial or leadership office in
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization, political body or institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: head/president/chair/director/chief/commander/executive/manager; equivalent explicit management such as dean or commissioner; a functional or departmental leadership office within Y; historical office. Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

strata.label: has lawyer or legal counsel
strata.definition: Client or institutional principal X is represented by or professionally affiliated with lawyer, attorney, or legal counsel Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer, attorney, or counsel for X; historical legal representation or institutional legal office; public attorney for the named jurisdiction. Excludes: ordinary spokesperson, adviser, or employee without a legal role; a place where a lawyer practices without client or institutional affiliation; a third party lawyer merely quoted about X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear legal client versus geographic location; lawyer title attachment unresolved; an incomplete principal. Inverse of lawyer_for. This does not require that the legal professional exclusively represents X.

strata.label: born in
strata.definition: Person X was born in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: direct born-in; born into a family in Y when Y is the birth location. Excludes: grown up/raised/native/from alone; nationality; schooling/residence/travel; institution founding. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear person or birthplace attachment.

strata.label: organization based or located in
strata.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: based/headquarters/campus/office in; company/firm/group in a place; clear company/firm geographic noun modifiers; historical organizational location. Excludes: industry/Internet or corporate-family/Bell association; person birthplace/residence/occupation; mere event location; ownership or employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

strata.label: organization based or located in
strata.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: based/headquarters/campus/office in; company/firm/group in a place; clear company/firm geographic noun modifiers; historical organizational location. Excludes: industry/Internet or corporate-family/Bell association; person birthplace/residence/occupation; mere event location; ownership or employment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: nationality adjective alone; truncated country/place; Wall Street as place versus industry. A shortened organization name may be resolved by its own explicit company/unit role. No location evidence is imported from a different latent fact.

strata.label: reviews works in medium
strata.definition: Person X critically reviews artistic works or editions presented in medium Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit review of a collection, edition or version identified by the medium; historical critical review in the identified medium. Excludes: review of a performer or venue alone; the publication carrying the review rather than the medium of the reviewed work; merely mentioning or producing the medium. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear whether Y identifies the reviewed-work medium or the review publication; missing critic or review attachment. This is a distinct argument relation from reviews_artistic_output_of. A DVD collection review can establish the medium even if the work title is omitted.

strata.label: acted jointly with
strata.definition: Entity X explicitly acted jointly or cooperated with counterpart Y in a shared action.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit cooperation or joint action; joining Y in a specified shared action; historical realized cooperation. Excludes: joining an institution as a member; physical arrival, river confluence, or ordinary accompaniment; a generic relationship without a shared action; fighting against Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: join alone with no shared action supplied; plans or proposed cooperation without realization; unclear cooperative versus adversarial action. A narrow joint-action meaning, not a generic association. With truncated join-only paths and no action context, use A rather than assuming what the entities did together.

strata.label: dismissed person from role
strata.definition: Person or institution X fired or dismissed person Y from a professional or official role.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit firing or dismissal; clearly terminating Y's role; historical dismissal. Excludes: criticizing or blaming alone; X taking Y's role without evidence of dismissing Y; ordinary departure or voluntary resignation; dismissing an argument rather than a person from a role. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: replace where removal versus succession is unresolved; a proposed firing without realization; unclear actor or dismissed person. The dismissing actor need not become the successor. This is separate from succeeded_person.

strata.label: moves or travels to
strata.definition: Person, group or organization X undertakes movement with geographic destination Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: move/relocate/return/arrive/go/visit to Y; depart/leave for Y; temporary travel or organizational relocation; bare unqualified destination movement as textual support. Excludes: leave/withdraw from Y; mere presence/residence/death place; sports-event qualification or attendance as a nongeographic destination; membership or political control. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: explicitly hypothetical or proposed relocation; invasion-only boundary; geographic/team or theatrical metonymy. Permanent residence and completed arrival are not required. Do not import external history to reject an otherwise unqualified textual movement path.

strata.label: coach of
strata.definition: Person X coaches or coached sports team or collegiate athletic program Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit coach title; direct coaching with correct subject and team; former/dismissed coach with clear office evidence; team/university shorthand when the athletic program role is clear. Excludes: manager/president/player alone; winning with a team alone; vacancy consideration alone; reverse team-to-coach direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: missing coach subject or team attachment.

strata.label: has policy towards
strata.definition: Government or institution X has an explicitly identified policy directed toward entity Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit X policy-toward Y; an identified institutional policy concerning Y; historical policy target. Excludes: trade, travel, armed conflict, or ordinary relations without a policy assertion; an individual statement without institutional policy attribution; generic support or opposition alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear policy owner or target; a proposed policy without establishment; a topic or population substituted for an unresolved entity. This identifies the policy target only; it does not assert a favorable stance, diplomatic relations, or policy effectiveness.

strata.label: moves or travels to
strata.definition: Person, group or organization X undertakes movement with geographic destination Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: move/relocate/return/arrive/go/visit to Y; depart/leave for Y; temporary travel or organizational relocation; bare unqualified destination movement as textual support. Excludes: leave/withdraw from Y; mere presence/residence/death place; sports-event qualification or attendance as a nongeographic destination; membership or political control. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: explicitly hypothetical or proposed relocation; invasion-only boundary; geographic/team or theatrical metonymy. Permanent residence and completed arrival are not required. Do not import external history to reject an otherwise unqualified textual movement path.

strata.label: defeated opponent
strata.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

strata.label: political body has a leader
strata.definition: Country, political body or legislature X has or had person Y as a political leader.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: national president/ruler/head of government; named parliamentary majority/minority leader or whip; historical leadership. Excludes: corporate/team leadership; ordinary membership/meeting; party control instead of an individual leader; person-to-body forward direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unspecified minister without evidence of head-of-government or leadership scope; truncated body or unnamed officeholder. Harmonizes the later minister-inclusive samples to the original full-census scope. An unspecified minister alone is A, not automatically S.

strata.label: has or had medical condition
strata.definition: Person X, or an explicitly identified subset of population X, has or had medical condition Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit having or suffering from Y; diagnosis of Y; death from or of Y establishing the condition; a stated affected subset of a named population. Excludes: generic discussion or research about Y; treating another person with Y; a disease merely located in a place; a generic have phrase whose object is not a medical condition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear condition attachment or affected person; risk, possible diagnosis, or suspected condition without confirmation; a population mention that does not identify affected members. This is annotation of textual support, not medical guidance. A population fact does not imply every member has the condition.

strata.label: manager of institution
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified manager office in organization, team, business, or public institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit manager or general manager; a functional or departmental managerial office within Y; historical managerial office. Excludes: president, director, head, executive, or coach alone without a manager title; ordinary employment or membership; candidate or proposed appointment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: a personal principal standing for an omitted institution or campaign; unclear manager or institutional attachment; appointment without established tenure. This specific title is separate from president_or_manager_of and managerial_office_in. A sports manager qualifies; merely coaching does not prove the manager title.

strata.label: director of organization
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office of, for or at organization or institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit director/co-director; functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y; historical office. Excludes: head/president/chair/executive alone; spokesperson/adviser/publisher/professor/member alone; performing or authorship alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal with omitted organization; abstract topic in place of the actual institution. Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.

strata.label: leader or organizational head of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held a leader, head, president, chief or chair office in group, institution, organization or political body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit leader/head/president/chief/chair; legislative majority/minority leadership or whip; leadership office within an identified body; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership or service; founding/ownership alone; party control of a chamber; candidate alone; athletic/standings or task-only lead; editor alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic director or executive without clear leadership role; bare lead lacking organizational-role context; materially truncated political body. Preserves the narrower leader/head family used in the two original full censuses; managerial_office_in separately accepts explicit director/executive titles.

strata.label: physically present in place
strata.definition: Entity X is or was physically present in geographic place Y, temporarily or as a resident or located institution.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit unqualified physical be-in or presence; a direct residence or physical location statement; a completed arrival, visit, or departure that establishes presence in Y. Excludes: membership in an organization; participation or victory in a nongeographic event; political office or control alone; discussion, publication, or other abstract presence; a destination without evidence of realized movement or presence. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place-versus-institution metonymy; an incomplete geographic argument; uncertain attachment or explicit hypothetical presence. Physical presence is weaker than residence or headquarters. Those narrower predicates retain their existing definitions. Do not infer a geographic location from membership or event participation.

strata.label: lawyer or attorney for
strata.definition: Person X serves or served as attorney, lawyer or legal counsel for client, employer, organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer/attorney/counsel for/at/with client or employer; legal employment at a firm; explicit governmental attorney office for a jurisdiction. Excludes: private lawyer merely located in a city; spokesperson/director/lobbyist alone; reverse client-to-lawyer direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city as location versus represented jurisdiction; firm partner without a clear legal-role attachment.

strata.label: chairperson of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held the office of chair or chairperson of organization or governing body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit chair/chairman/chairwoman/chairperson; co-chair if explicit; past tenure or resignation from that office. Excludes: president/head/executive/director alone; founder/owner/member alone; nomination/candidacy alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: ambiguous successor or appointment that does not establish tenure; chair of an omitted subunit. Do not widen a prior specific-chair declaration to managerial office because its facts would then score better.

strata.label: unresolved relation meaning
strata.definition: The complete relation dictionary and argument roles do not identify a coherent dominant predicate whose facts can be judged without inventing a scope.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicitly documented relation-level semantic indeterminacy after complete dictionary and argument-role inspection. Excludes: using ambiguity to omit difficult facts or change denominators; a broad association or disjunction invented to make unrelated meanings correct; using this marker when a coherent dominant family can be identified. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: all facts remain ambiguous because the relation meaning is unresolved. This is an evaluation marker, not a learned semantic relation. Every fact receives A with a case-specific question; retain all facts in denominators and separately report relation-semantic-indeterminacy counts.

strata.label: lives or has lived in
strata.definition: Person X, or members of population X, live or have lived in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: live/resident/residence/home-in; explicit resettlement or being raised there; death at own home in a place when home attachment is clear. Excludes: death/killing in a place without residence; birth alone; work/travel/visits/presence/office alone; a relative living there without attribution to X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: obituary person-of-city apposition; relative/home attachment. Population statements concern members of the population, not necessarily every member.

strata.label: executive of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

strata.label: ethicist at institution
strata.definition: Person X works or worked as an explicitly identified ethicist or bioethicist affiliated with institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit ethicist or bioethicist at/for/of institutional role; historical ethics professional affiliation. Excludes: director, professor, fellow or other office without an ethics role; generic discussion of ethics; being an ethical person rather than a professional ethicist. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear role or institutional attachment; a specialty subject replacing the employing or affiliated institution. Bioethics is a specific field within professional ethics. The relation does not evaluate the truth of ethical claims or infer an ethicist title from another academic office.

strata.label: executive of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

strata.label: location of organization or its office
strata.definition: Geographic place X hosts the physical location, base, or office of organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit organization location, headquarters, office, or base in X; a geographically identified office or division of Y located in X; historical physical organizational location. Excludes: X is a corporate subsidiary or parent rather than a geographic place; national affiliation alone without physical location; ordinary travel, discussion, or an unrelated event in X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution metonymy unresolved; a geographic division name without clear physical location; unclear organization or location attachment. This is the inverse direction of located_in. The presence of an office does not imply that all of Y is headquartered there; corporate ownership alone is not location.

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit professor; teaching at the institution; historical teaching affiliation. Excludes: expert/specialist/dean/researcher/analyst alone; attendance or institution location alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear teacher versus student attachment.

strata.label: participated in sporting event
strata.definition: Competitor or team X participated in sporting event or competition Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: actual played-in, competed-in, or appeared-in a sporting event; being in an event when competitive participation is clear; a completed win or title in the event, which entails participation. Excludes: plans, hopes, or qualification without established participation; attendance as spectator; membership in a league without participation in the designated event; non-sporting events or geographic presence alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: future or proposed participation; event occurrence or participant role unclear; a governing body or location substituted for an unresolved event. Participation does not require winning. Preserve defeated and winner_of as separate predicates where those meanings were declared.

strata.label: has diplomatic relations with
strata.definition: Country or government X maintains or maintained diplomatic relations with country or government Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit diplomatic relations; an ambassador of X accredited to Y; historical diplomatic relations. Excludes: ordinary trade, physical travel, or war alone; generic political or personal association; an ambassador merely visiting Y without accreditation; proposed relations without establishment. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic relationship or relation without diplomatic context; unclear government versus private entity; unclear ambassador accreditation or country attachment. Diplomatic relations do not imply alliance, friendship, or agreement on policy.

strata.label: strategist for institution
strata.definition: Person X explicitly serves or served as a strategist for institution or principal Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit strategist-at, strategist-for, or institutional strategist role; historical strategy office. Excludes: analyst or ordinary adviser alone; a comparison or strategy topic without affiliation; ordinary employment without strategist role. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear principal versus topic; strategist title attachment unresolved. A distinct occupational role; do not merge every analyst or adviser into it.

strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
strata.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

strata.label: moves or travels to
strata.definition: Person, group or organization X undertakes movement with geographic destination Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: move/relocate/return/arrive/go/visit to Y; depart/leave for Y; temporary travel or organizational relocation; bare unqualified destination movement as textual support. Excludes: leave/withdraw from Y; mere presence/residence/death place; sports-event qualification or attendance as a nongeographic destination; membership or political control. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: explicitly hypothetical or proposed relocation; invasion-only boundary; geographic/team or theatrical metonymy. Permanent residence and completed arrival are not required. Do not import external history to reject an otherwise unqualified textual movement path.

strata.label: contributed writing to publication
strata.definition: Person X wrote, reviewed or contributed as a critic for publication Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: wrote/reviewed for or in a publication; explicit critic for publication with authorship role. Excludes: merely quoted or mentioned in publication; publication location; ordinary communication or employment without authorship. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: say-in without author/quoted-speaker distinction.

strata.label: departed from
strata.definition: Person, group or organization X physically leaves or withdraws from geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: leave/withdraw/pull out from Y; historical physical departure. Excludes: arrival/return to Y; residence alone; leaving a job or team as an institution without geography. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution as source; explicitly conditional departure.

strata.label: has lawyer or legal counsel
strata.definition: Client or institutional principal X is represented by or professionally affiliated with lawyer, attorney, or legal counsel Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer, attorney, or counsel for X; historical legal representation or institutional legal office; public attorney for the named jurisdiction. Excludes: ordinary spokesperson, adviser, or employee without a legal role; a place where a lawyer practices without client or institutional affiliation; a third party lawyer merely quoted about X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear legal client versus geographic location; lawyer title attachment unresolved; an incomplete principal. Inverse of lawyer_for. This does not require that the legal professional exclusively represents X.

strata.label: institutional officer of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified professional officer role in institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit officer of/with/at institutional role; historical institutional officership. Excludes: ordinary employment or membership without an officer title; researcher, observer, analyst or director alone; inferring executive rank or governmental authority from the word officer. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear officer title or institutional attachment; a personal principal or topic replacing the institution. This specific officer title is distinct from executive_of and official_of. It does not assert senior management or a government office.

strata.label: winner or champion of
strata.definition: Entity X won the award or competition designated by Y, or held an explicitly Y-designated championship title.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. Excludes: participation or reaching the event; single stage/game victory without the overall title; winning political office/control of a body; location or ordinary membership. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title/event attachment; medal without a clear winning title or award scope. A named boxing body can designate its explicit title; mark broad_predicate rather than claiming the body itself was won. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.

strata.label: leader or organizational head of

Preserves the narrower leader/head family used in the two original full censuses; managerial_office_in separately accepts explicit director/executive titles.

strata.label: managerial or leadership office in

Excludes: founder or owner alone; ordinary employment/membership; spokesperson/adviser/lawyer/analyst/editor alone; athletic or standings lead; candidacy or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal standing for an omitted campaign or institution; unclear leadership attachment. This is the prior broad office family. It does not require sole overall leadership of Y. Explicit editor-in-chief or other equivalent head office differs from editor alone.

strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. strata.label: adviser to principal

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit adviser/advisor-to or possessive adviser role; an identified counselor providing advisory service; historical advisory role. Excludes: director, lawyer, or formal leadership title alone; ordinary communication or acquaintance; confidant alone without advisory service; expertise on a topic rather than advice to a principal. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: an omitted or materially incomplete principal; counselor versus legal counsel attachment unresolved; advisory topic substituted for principal. The principal may be a person or institution. Advice does not imply formal management or spokesperson authority.

strata.label: has organizational or political leader

Excludes: ordinary membership; geographic co-occurrence; interactions without office; forward person-to-body direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete principal or office attachment. Use only where the prior declaration actually included organizations generally, not to widen a political-only relation.

strata.label: has lawyer or legal counsel

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer, attorney, or counsel for X; historical legal representation or institutional legal office; public attorney for the named jurisdiction. Excludes: ordinary spokesperson, adviser, or employee without a legal role; a place where a lawyer practices without client or institutional affiliation; a third party lawyer merely quoted about X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear legal client versus geographic location; lawyer title attachment unresolved; an incomplete principal. Inverse of lawyer_for. This does not require that the legal professional exclusively represents X.

strata.label: president of institution
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president office in organization, team, public body, or institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit president office; a functional or departmental president role within Y; historical or former presidency. Excludes: manager, director, chairman, head, or executive alone without a president title; ordinary employment or membership; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: president-elect or unresolved tenure without evidence of holding office; an incomplete institution or personal principal; unclear holder or title attachment. This specific title is separate from president_or_manager_of and managerial_office_in. It does not require that the officeholder be the sole head of Y.

strata.label: political candidate or nominee for party
strata.definition: Person X is or was an explicitly identified candidate, contender for nomination, or nominee of political party Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit party candidate or nominee; front-runner or contender for the party nomination; historical candidacy or nomination. Excludes: holding an executive or other office without party candidacy; merely supporting or belonging to the party; candidacy for a corporate or sporting appointment. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: a constituency or office appears where the political party is omitted; candidate or nomination attachment does not identify whose party nomination is sought; the purported party is materially truncated or unidentified. This is a candidacy relation and does not claim election or actual office. The second role is the political party, not the office being contested. Republican as an identified party label follows the inherited party-label convention.

strata.label: manager of institution
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified manager office in organization, team, business, or public institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit manager or general manager; a functional or departmental managerial office within Y; historical managerial office. Excludes: president, director, head, executive, or coach alone without a manager title; ordinary employment or membership; candidate or proposed appointment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: a personal principal standing for an omitted institution or campaign; unclear manager or institutional attachment; appointment without established tenure. This specific title is separate from president_or_manager_of and managerial_office_in. A sports manager qualifies; merely coaching does not prove the manager title.

strata.label: fought military conflict against
strata.definition: Political entity or military group X fought an armed conflict or war against Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit war-with or fought-against in an armed-conflict context; actual military attack or combat against Y; historical military adversaries. Excludes: sports competition or metaphorical political attack; cooperation, alliance, or joint action on the same side; border adjacency or diplomatic relations alone; planned conflict without realization. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: fight-with whose allied versus adversarial sense is unresolved; generic attack without military context; future threat or proposed war. Military adversarial conflict is distinct from cooperation and from criticizing. The predicate does not imply a winner.

Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: all facts remain ambiguous because the relation meaning is unresolved. This is an evaluation marker, not a learned semantic relation. Every fact receives A with a case-specific question; retain all facts in denominators and separately report relation-semantic-indeterminacy counts.

strata.label: executive of

strata.label: physically present in place

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit unqualified physical be-in or presence; a direct residence or physical location statement; a completed arrival, visit, or departure that establishes presence in Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place-versus-institution metonymy; an incomplete geographic argument; uncertain attachment or explicit hypothetical presence. strata.label: organization based or located in

strata.label: organization described by national affiliation

strata.label: promotes ideology of

strata.label: has or had wife
